meta_description: Read and hear KJV Bible verses for sleepless nights. Enjoy whispered Psalms, daily prayers, and no surprise charges on your phone.
direct_answer: Bible verses for sleepless nights are passages from the Holy Scriptures that you read or hear in the dark to quiet your racing thoughts and anchor your heart in God's peace. A nightly practice of scripture helps your mind let go of the day before you rest.

sections.heading: What does the Bible say about quiet rest?
paragraphs: When the night is long and sleep stays away, your bed can feel like a lonely place. The quiet hours often bring worries that hid in the sun. God knows every toss and turn. He does not sleep. He watches over you in the dark just as He does in the day.

The King James Version gives us words to lean on when your eyes remain open. You can turn to the Psalms when the house is still. Listen to a whispered voice read the ancient verses that have comforted generations of believers before you.

Psalm 4:8 says: "I will both lay me down in peace, and sleep: for thou, Lord, only makest me dwell in safety." This is a quiet promise to hold in your heart. You are safe in your room. The Lord is keeping watch while you close your eyes.

You might also read Bible verses for anxiety (KJV), grouped by what you feel to find the exact words that match your burden tonight. Let the scriptures wash over your mind. Put down the cares of tomorrow until the morning sun rises.

sections.heading: How can whispered Psalms help your night routine?
paragraphs: Listening to scripture in the dark is an old and gentle habit. A soft, whispered voice reads the verses without rushing. You can set a sleep timer so the reading fades away as your breathing slows down. This keeps the room peaceful.

Many women find that hearing the words read aloud takes the effort out of reading tiny print in a dim room. You simply lie back and listen. The rhythm of the King James Version calms a busy mind. It reminds you of God's steady hand on your life.

If you prefer to read yourself, the pages glow softly on your screen. You can move at your own pace through the chapters. There are no ads to jank your focus or bright flashing lights to wake you up further. Just the plain text of Scripture.

Peace Be Still brings these quiet readings directly to your phone. It is a coming-soon phone app for the App Store and Google Play. You can prepare your heart for rest without distractions or loud noises interrupting your holy hour.

sections.heading: Can I talk to an AI Bible chat in the middle of the night?
paragraphs: Sometimes a specific question keeps you awake. You might wonder where a certain verse is located or what a passage means. You can open the Bible chat feature to ask your questions at any hour of the night.

This tool is clearly labelled as artificial intelligence. It does not pretend to be a person or a pastor. It simply searches the text and answers you by quoting KJV verses word for word. You get direct scripture without human opinions getting in the way.

If you share your home with Spanish speakers, the app includes Mi Refugio: Biblia y chat en español con la Reina-Valera 1909. Your whole family can read and listen in the language of their heart. Everyone finds comfort before the morning light.

You can also read Hush Harbor for a daily Bible story, featuring Bible stories with Black faces. These narratives bring the rich heritage of the faith to life. They connect your spirit to the ancestors who also looked to God in the night watches.

sections.heading: What is the cost of this Bible app?
paragraphs: Choosing a tool for your devotional life should be straightforward. Many apps trap you with hidden fees or sudden charges after a short week. This app offers a free lane forever so you can read without paying a dime.

If you choose to unlock the full library of whispered Psalms and extra tools, the paid lane is seven dollars and ninety-nine cents a month or thirty-nine dollars and ninety-year. There is no trial period that rolls over into a surprise bill.
You always know what you pay. There are zero advertisements to break your concentration during prayer. Your quiet time belongs to you and the Lord alone.
Look for Peace Be Still in the App Store and Google Play.

faq.q: What Bible version does the app use?
faq.a: The app uses the King James Version for English readers and the Reina-Valera 1909 for Spanish speakers. Every verse is quoted word for word from these classic texts without any paraphrasing or modern changes to the holy language.

faq.q: How do the whispered Psalms work at bedtime?
faq.a: Whispered Psalms are audio recordings of scripture read in a very soft voice designed for night listening. You can set a sleep timer so the audio stops automatically after a set duration while you drift off.

faq.q: Are there Spanish scriptures available for bedtime?
faq.a: Yes, Spanish-speaking families can use Mi Refugio to read the Reina-Valera 1909 Bible and chat in Spanish. This ensures everyone in your household finds comfort in their preferred language during the late hours of the night.

faq.q: How much does the app cost after I download it?
faq.a: There is a free lane that costs nothing forever. The paid lane is seven dollars and ninety-nine cents a month or thirty-nine dollars and ninety-nine cents a year with no trial and no surprise charges.

facts.claim: The King James Version is an English translation of the Christian Bible completed in 1611 under the sponsorship of King James I of England.
The Reina-Valera is one of the most frequently used Spanish translations of the Bible among Protestants.
